title: public.record_ooo_followup — TARGET ingestion contract
description: The RPC this workflow must call instead of writing leads/sheets (ADR-0015 §5). Signature transcribed from supabase/migrations/20260722e_ooo_rpcs.sql. SECURITY DEFINER, service_role only. Not called by the workflow yet — this file is the contract the cutover implements.

p_sequencer_contact_id.description: uuid — from upsert_sequencer_contact(client_sequencer_id, external_contact_id, …). The scoped identity; a bare Bison lead id is NOT sufficient.

p_source_reply_id.description: uuid|null — from upsert_reply(). Carries the second idempotency invariant: uq_ooo_followups_source_reply stops a redelivered event opening a duplicate episode once the previous one is 'submitted' and the active index no longer covers it.

p_expected_return_date.description: date|null — the date ACTUALLY PARSED from the reply. MUST be null when none was parseable. Never a fallback: this column is read as a fact (ADR-0015 §2). Passing null on a repeat OOO reply does not erase a previously known date.

p_scheduled_for.description: date|null — when to re-enrol. MAY be a fallback (today + 2 when omitted). This is where a guess belongs.

x-returns.description: The ooo_followups row. Status is NOT always 'pending': missing routing yields 'skipped' + routing_missing, and clients.auto_ooo_enabled=false yields 'skipped' + automation_disabled. Both are visible states, never silent drops — the caller must not treat a non-pending return as an error.

x-invariants: uq_ooo_followups_active — at most ONE active episode per contact (active = pending|processing|failed).
uq_ooo_followups_source_reply — one episode per source reply.
Routing resolution is specific routing_key → 'general' → NULL; NULL surfaces as skipped/routing_missing.
The routing snapshot (routing_key + target_campaign_id + routing_source) freezes once the episode leaves an active status, so later config changes cannot rewrite history.

x-related.onPositiveReply: promote_contact_to_lead — creates the CRM lead (one per contact) AND cancels the active episode.
